# TypeScript Instructions

## Purpose

This document defines TypeScript coding standards for the frontend application. These rules apply to both Angular and React implementations.

## General Principles

1. **Type Safety**: Leverage TypeScript's type system fully
2. **Explicit over Implicit**: Prefer explicit types over `any`
3. **Immutability**: Favor immutable patterns
4. **Functional**: Use functional programming patterns where appropriate
5. **Consistency**: Follow established patterns in the codebase

## TypeScript Configuration

### tsconfig.json Standards

Ensure strict mode is enabled:

```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "strict": true,
    "noImplicitAny": true,
    "strictNullChecks": true,
    "strictFunctionTypes": true,
    "strictBindCallApply": true,
    "strictPropertyInitialization": true,
    "noImplicitThis": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "noImplicitReturns": true,
    "noFallthroughCasesInSwitch": true
  }
}
```

## Type Definitions

### Interfaces vs Types

**Use Interfaces for:**
- Object shapes
- Class contracts
- When you need declaration merging
- Public API contracts

```typescript
interface TodoItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  done: boolean;
  priority: PriorityLevel;
}

interface TodoService {
  getAll(): Promise<TodoItem[]>;
  create(item: CreateTodoItemDto): Promise<TodoItem>;
}
```

**Use Types for:**
- Union types
- Intersection types
- Mapped types
- Utility types

```typescript
type TodoItemStatus = 'pending' | 'completed' | 'cancelled';
type TodoItemId = string;
type PartialTodoItem = Partial<TodoItem>;
type TodoItemKeys = keyof TodoItem;
```

### Naming Conventions

**Interfaces and Types:**
```typescript
// ✅ DO: PascalCase
interface TodoItem { }
type TodoStatus = string;

// ❌ DON'T: Prefix with I
interface ITodoItem { }  // Don't use I prefix
```

**Type Aliases:**
```typescript
// ✅ DO: Descriptive names
type TodoItemId = string;
type CreateTodoItemRequest = Omit<TodoItem, 'id'>;

// ❌ DON'T: Generic names
type Id = string;
type Request = any;
```

### DTOs (Data Transfer Objects)

Match the backend DTO structure from NSwag generation:

```typescript
// Generated by NSwag from backend
export interface TodoItemDto {
  id: string;
  listId: number;
  title: string;
  done: boolean;
  priority: PriorityLevel;
  note?: string;
  created: Date;
  lastModified: Date;
}

export interface CreateTodoItemCommand {
  listId: number;
  title: string;
  priority?: PriorityLevel;
}
```

**Rules for DTOs:**
- Keep in sync with backend through NSwag generation
- Don't manually modify generated files
- Use optional properties (`?`) for nullable fields
- Use proper types for dates (`Date`, not `string`)

## Type Safety Best Practices

### Avoid `any`

```typescript
// ❌ BAD
function processData(data: any) {
  return data.value;
}

// ✅ GOOD
function processData<T extends { value: string }>(data: T): string {
  return data.value;
}

// ✅ GOOD - When you really don't know the type
function processData(data: unknown) {
  if (typeof data === 'object' && data !== null && 'value' in data) {
    return (data as { value: string }).value;
  }
  throw new Error('Invalid data');
}
```

### Null Safety

```typescript
// ❌ BAD - Assuming value exists
function getTitle(item: TodoItem) {
  return item.title.toUpperCase();
}

// ✅ GOOD - Handle nullable values
function getTitle(item: TodoItem | null | undefined): string {
  return item?.title?.toUpperCase() ?? 'Untitled';
}

// ✅ GOOD - Type guards
function getTitle(item: TodoItem | null): string {
  if (!item || !item.title) {
    return 'Untitled';
  }
  return item.title.toUpperCase();
}
```

### Type Guards

```typescript
// Custom type guard
function isTodoItem(obj: unknown): obj is TodoItem {
  return (
    typeof obj === 'object' &&
    obj !== null &&
    'id' in obj &&
    'title' in obj &&
    'done' in obj
  );
}

// Usage
function processTodo(data: unknown) {
  if (isTodoItem(data)) {
    // TypeScript knows data is TodoItem here
    console.log(data.title);
  }
}
```

### Generics

```typescript
// ✅ Generic function
function getById<T extends { id: string }>(items: T[], id: string): T | undefined {
  return items.find(item => item.id === id);
}

// ✅ Generic interface
interface ApiResponse<T> {
  data: T;
  status: number;
  message?: string;
}

// ✅ Generic class
class DataStore<T> {
  private items: T[] = [];

  add(item: T): void {
    this.items.push(item);
  }

  getAll(): T[] {
    return [...this.items];
  }
}
```

## Functions and Methods

### Function Signatures

```typescript
// ✅ Explicit return types
function calculateTotal(items: TodoItem[]): number {
  return items.length;
}

// ✅ Async functions
async function fetchTodoItems(): Promise<TodoItem[]> {
  const response = await fetch('/api/todos');
  return response.json();
}

// ✅ Arrow functions with types
const filterCompleted = (items: TodoItem[]): TodoItem[] => {
  return items.filter(item => item.done);
};

// ✅ Optional parameters
function createTodo(title: string, priority?: PriorityLevel): TodoItem {
  return {
    id: generateId(),
    title,
    done: false,
    priority: priority ?? PriorityLevel.Normal
  };
}

// ✅ Default parameters
function createTodo(title: string, priority: PriorityLevel = PriorityLevel.Normal): TodoItem {
  return { id: generateId(), title, done: false, priority };
}
```

### Callback Types

```typescript
// ✅ Define callback types
type TodoItemCallback = (item: TodoItem) => void;
type TodoItemPredicate = (item: TodoItem) => boolean;

function processTodos(items: TodoItem[], callback: TodoItemCallback): void {
  items.forEach(callback);
}

function filterTodos(items: TodoItem[], predicate: TodoItemPredicate): TodoItem[] {
  return items.filter(predicate);
}
```

## Classes

### Class Structure

```typescript
class TodoService {
  // Private fields with # or private
  private readonly apiUrl: string;
  #cache: Map<string, TodoItem>;

  // Constructor with dependency injection
  constructor(
    private readonly http: HttpClient,
    private readonly config: AppConfig
  ) {
    this.apiUrl = config.apiUrl;
    this.#cache = new Map();
  }

  // Public methods with explicit return types
  async getAll(): Promise<TodoItem[]> {
    const response = await this.http.get<TodoItem[]>(`${this.apiUrl}/todos`);
    return response;
  }

  async getById(id: string): Promise<TodoItem | null> {
    // Check cache first
    const cached = this.#cache.get(id);
    if (cached) return cached;

    const item = await this.http.get<TodoItem>(`${this.apiUrl}/todos/${id}`);
    this.#cache.set(id, item);
    return item;
  }

  // Private helper methods
  private clearCache(): void {
    this.#cache.clear();
  }
}
```

### Abstract Classes and Inheritance

```typescript
abstract class BaseService<T> {
  constructor(protected readonly http: HttpClient) {}

  abstract getEndpoint(): string;

  async getAll(): Promise<T[]> {
    return this.http.get<T[]>(this.getEndpoint());
  }

  async getById(id: string): Promise<T> {
    return this.http.get<T>(`${this.getEndpoint()}/${id}`);
  }
}

class TodoService extends BaseService<TodoItem> {
  getEndpoint(): string {
    return '/api/todos';
  }
}
```

## Enums vs Union Types

### Use Enums for Backend Compatibility

When matching backend enums:

```typescript
// ✅ Matches backend C# enum
export enum PriorityLevel {
  None = 0,
  Low = 1,
  Medium = 2,
  High = 3
}
```

### Use Union Types for Frontend-Only Values

```typescript
// ✅ Frontend-only states
type LoadingState = 'idle' | 'loading' | 'success' | 'error';
type Theme = 'light' | 'dark' | 'auto';

// ✅ With const assertion
const THEME = {
  LIGHT: 'light',
  DARK: 'dark',
  AUTO: 'auto'
} as const;

type Theme = typeof THEME[keyof typeof THEME];
```

## Utility Types

### Built-in Utility Types

```typescript
interface TodoItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  done: boolean;
  priority: PriorityLevel;
  note?: string;
}

// Partial - All properties optional
type PartialTodoItem = Partial<TodoItem>;
// { id?: string; title?: string; done?: boolean; ... }

// Required - All properties required
type RequiredTodoItem = Required<TodoItem>;
// { id: string; title: string; done: boolean; note: string; }

// Pick - Select specific properties
type TodoItemPreview = Pick<TodoItem, 'id' | 'title'>;
// { id: string; title: string; }

// Omit - Exclude specific properties
type CreateTodoItemDto = Omit<TodoItem, 'id'>;
// { title: string; done: boolean; priority: PriorityLevel; note?: string; }

// Record - Key-value map
type TodoItemMap = Record<string, TodoItem>;
// { [key: string]: TodoItem }

// Readonly - Immutable
type ReadonlyTodoItem = Readonly<TodoItem>;
// { readonly id: string; readonly title: string; ... }
```

### Custom Utility Types

```typescript
// Deep partial
type DeepPartial<T> = {
  [P in keyof T]?: T[P] extends object ? DeepPartial<T[P]> : T[P];
};

// Deep readonly
type DeepReadonly<T> = {
  readonly [P in keyof T]: T[P] extends object ? DeepReadonly<T[P]> : T[P];
};

// Non-nullable
type NonNullableFields<T> = {
  [P in keyof T]: NonNullable<T[P]>;
};
```

## API Client Patterns

### Using NSwag Generated Client

```typescript
import { TodoItemsClient, CreateTodoItemCommand } from './api-client';

// ✅ Use generated client
@Injectable()
export class TodoService {
  constructor(private readonly client: TodoItemsClient) {}

  async getAll(): Promise<TodoItemDto[]> {
    return this.client.getTodoItems();
  }

  async create(command: CreateTodoItemCommand): Promise<number> {
    return this.client.createTodoItem(command);
  }
}
```

### Error Handling

```typescript
// ✅ Typed error handling
interface ApiError {
  status: number;
  message: string;
  errors?: Record<string, string[]>;
}

async function handleApiCall<T>(
  apiCall: () => Promise<T>
): Promise<T> {
  try {
    return await apiCall();
  } catch (error) {
    if (isApiError(error)) {
      // Handle known API error
      throw new Error(error.message);
    }
    // Handle unknown error
    throw new Error('An unexpected error occurred');
  }
}

function isApiError(error: unknown): error is ApiError {
  return (
    typeof error === 'object' &&
    error !== null &&
    'status' in error &&
    'message' in error
  );
}
```

## Reactive Programming (RxJS)

### Observable Patterns

```typescript
import { Observable, Subject, BehaviorSubject } from 'rxjs';
import { map, filter, catchError, shareReplay } from 'rxjs/operators';

// ✅ Service with observables
@Injectable()
export class TodoStore {
  private readonly todosSubject = new BehaviorSubject<TodoItem[]>([]);
  
  // Expose as readonly observable
  readonly todos$: Observable<TodoItem[]> = this.todosSubject.asObservable();

  // Derived observables
  readonly completedTodos$: Observable<TodoItem[]> = this.todos$.pipe(
    map(todos => todos.filter(t => t.done)),
    shareReplay(1)
  );

  readonly incompleteTodos$: Observable<TodoItem[]> = this.todos$.pipe(
    map(todos => todos.filter(t => !t.done)),
    shareReplay(1)
  );

  addTodo(todo: TodoItem): void {
    const current = this.todosSubject.value;
    this.todosSubject.next([...current, todo]);
  }

  updateTodo(id: string, updates: Partial<TodoItem>): void {
    const current = this.todosSubject.value;
    const updated = current.map(todo =>
      todo.id === id ? { ...todo, ...updates } : todo
    );
    this.todosSubject.next(updated);
  }
}
```

### Type-Safe RxJS

```typescript
// ✅ Typed operators
const numbers$ = of(1, 2, 3, 4, 5);

const doubled$: Observable<number> = numbers$.pipe(
  map((n: number) => n * 2)
);

const strings$: Observable<string> = numbers$.pipe(
  map((n: number) => n.toString())
);

// ✅ Error handling
const todos$: Observable<TodoItem[]> = this.http.get<TodoItem[]>('/api/todos').pipe(
  catchError((error: unknown) => {
    console.error('Failed to load todos', error);
    return of([] as TodoItem[]);
  })
);
```

## Immutability Patterns

### Immutable Updates

```typescript
// ❌ BAD - Mutation
function completeTodo(todo: TodoItem): TodoItem {
  todo.done = true;
  return todo;
}

// ✅ GOOD - Immutable
function completeTodo(todo: TodoItem): TodoItem {
  return { ...todo, done: true };
}

// ✅ GOOD - Array updates
function addTodo(todos: TodoItem[], newTodo: TodoItem): TodoItem[] {
  return [...todos, newTodo];
}

function removeTodo(todos: TodoItem[], id: string): TodoItem[] {
  return todos.filter(todo => todo.id !== id);
}

function updateTodo(todos: TodoItem[], id: string, updates: Partial<TodoItem>): TodoItem[] {
  return todos.map(todo =>
    todo.id === id ? { ...todo, ...updates } : todo
  );
}
```

### Readonly Types

```typescript
// ✅ Readonly arrays
function processTodos(todos: readonly TodoItem[]): void {
  // todos.push() // Error: Property 'push' does not exist
  const completed = todos.filter(t => t.done); // OK
}

// ✅ Readonly objects
interface Config {
  readonly apiUrl: string;
  readonly timeout: number;
}

const config: Readonly<Config> = {
  apiUrl: 'https://api.example.com',
  timeout: 5000
};

// config.apiUrl = 'new url'; // Error: Cannot assign to 'apiUrl'
```

## Best Practices

### ✅ DO

```typescript
// Use const assertions
const COLORS = {
  PRIMARY: '#007bff',
  SECONDARY: '#6c757d',
  SUCCESS: '#28a745'
} as const;

// Use discriminated unions
type Result<T> =
  | { success: true; data: T }
  | { success: false; error: string };

// Use type narrowing
function processResult<T>(result: Result<T>): T {
  if (result.success) {
    return result.data; // TypeScript knows this is safe
  }
  throw new Error(result.error);
}

// Use strict equality
if (value === null) { }
if (array.length === 0) { }

// Use nullish coalescing
const value = userInput ?? defaultValue;

// Use optional chaining
const title = todo?.title?.toUpperCase();
```

### ❌ DON'T

```typescript
// Don't use any
function process(data: any) { } // BAD

// Don't use non-null assertion unnecessarily
const title = todo!.title!; // BAD - handle nulls properly

// Don't use == (loose equality)
if (value == null) { } // BAD - use === or ??

// Don't ignore errors
async function loadData() {
  await fetch('/api/data'); // BAD - no error handling
}

// Don't use Type Assertion without good reason
const element = document.getElementById('app') as HTMLDivElement; // Risky
```

## Testing Types

### Type Testing

```typescript
// Use type assertions in tests
import { expectType } from 'tsd';

expectType<TodoItem[]>(await service.getAll());
expectType<number>(await service.create(command));
```

### Mock Types

```typescript
// Create mock types for testing
type MockTodoItem = Partial<TodoItem> & Pick<TodoItem, 'id'>;

const mockTodo: MockTodoItem = {
  id: '123',
  title: 'Test'
};
```
